name: State Disaster Management Control Room (1070)
department: Home Department / MP State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)
beneficiary: Populations affected by floods, earthquakes, industrial accidents, and severe weather
benefits: Disaster response coordination, evacuation assistance, and relief tracking.
eligibility: Residents affected by natural or man-made disasters in MP
application_process: Dial 1070 from landline or mobile to reach state emergency control.
